title: Worst Assembly Experience!
text: Worst Assembly Experience!. My language during assembly was not nice! I have assembled many pieces of furniture and this was THE worst experience that I've ever had! Barely any written instruction and terrible picture representation. Would never recommend. Disappointed in the manufacturer. There has to be a more simple design. I would have sent it back if I had not invested so much time and effort.  Not sturdy at all. Flimsy. Paper-like plastic. Would not recommend this product.

product_metadata.title: SONGMICS Shoe Rack, 10-Slot Storage Organizer Unit with Doors, Portable Cube Shoe Storage Organizer, Plastic Modular DIY Storage Shelf, Closet Divider for Clothes Bags Toys, Transparent ULPC506T01
features: [Organize Your Shoe Mess With...] this 10-slot storage organizer unit! Its lockable, water- and dust-resistant doors will keep your 10-20 pairs of shoes clean, tidy, and well-organized (and you free from the stress of finding the right pair)

[Save Your Space] Not a lot of room in your room? SONGMICS saves you some! With a floor space of 12.2”D x 16.9”W, this interlocking storage organizer unit rises upwards to make better use of unoccupied vertical space

[Don’t Limit Yourself] If you prefer to put clothes, toys, and even larger bags in this modular cabinet, no problem! Its dividers are adjustable with hooks. Have 5 slots of 11.8”D x 15.7”W x 11.8”H, or 10 slots of 11.8”D x 15.7”W x 5.9”H, it’s up to you

[Say Yes to a Safe Home] A robust metal frame and reinforced fittings made of ABS plastic ensure this PP plastic shelf holds up to 220 lb when evenly distributed; an included anti-tip kit means you don’t need to worry about kids tipping the organizer over

[Assembly?] No Headaches! Simply follow the illustrated instructions, attach the panels with the connectors, tap with the included mallet, snap the hooks, insert the dividers as needed, and that’s it. No difficulties involved!

details.Material: PP (Polypropylene) Plastic Sheet, Metal Frame, ABS Plastic Fitting
